text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down moderately over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 3.4% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 2.6%, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins into BTC's relative safety. The Fear & Greed index at 20 (Extreme Fear) reflects broad risk-off sentiment, though the +9 jump over a week indicates some stabilization from worse conditions. At $77B in daily volume, markets are contracting compared to bullish periods, and Bitcoin's dominance holding near 56% shows investors are consolidating around the largest asset during uncertainty.
